about_the_game:
Arcane Shores is a city-building game about turning your simple ancient settlement into a magic-infused kingdom. But this will not be easy—this is not your land. A mysterious force makes clear that you are not welcome on this island, that you do not belong here.

Build Your Civilization

Start with the basics—construct houses for your growing population, taverns to keep spirits high, and churches to maintain order. But as your people explore the mysterious shores they call home, ancient secrets begin to surface. Mystical energies pulse beneath the earth, waiting to be harnessed by those bold enough to seek them.

Defend Against All Odds

Your growing power hasn't gone unnoticed. Hostile armies march toward your shores, drawn by rumors of your magical abilities. What they don't expect is the devastating welcome that awaits them. Deploy arcane towers that rain lightning from the skies, raise magical barriers to protect your people, and unleash supernatural forces that turn the tide of battle.

Evolve and Adapt

Every invasion teaches you something new. Study your enemies' tactics, develop countermeasures, and push your magical research to new heights. The primitive settlement you started with will become unrecognizable—a testament to the power of knowledge, magic, and unwavering determination.

Will your civilization master the arcane arts in time to survive? The shores hold infinite mysteries, but only the strongest will unlock them all.

Discover Arcane Powers

Uncover forgotten knowledge and tap into magical forces that will reshape your entire civilization. Research powerful spells, construct enchanted buildings, and train mages who can bend reality to your will. Each mystical discovery opens new possibilities for both creation and defense.

name: Arcane Shores

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible with 1 GB VRAM (GTX 750 Ti / R7 260X or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated graphics may experience reduced performance during large battles
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible with 2 GB VRAM (GTX 1060 / RX 580 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: For optimal performance during large-scale magical battles and city management

short_description: Arcane Shores is a city-building strategy game infused with magic. Build, defend, and expand your settlement while casting powerful spells that bend nature, restore what’s broken, and turn the tide against your enemies.
